market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver at $120 would require a >250% rally from current ~$32 within ~15 months, an event without historical precedent even during the 2011 spike to $50. The market-implied 6.8% probability is unjustifiably high; the true likelihood is well below 1%.
evidence_points: Silver spot price today is ~$32–34 vs. a $120 target, requiring a >3.5x move in little over a year.
CME active-month front-future silver all-time high is ~$50 (2011); a move beyond that by more than 2x is unprecedented.
No fundamental supply shock or monetary collapse scenario visible in early 2025 credits such a rapid 4x surge.
